title: U.S. BUS CORPORATION: U.S. BUS/FMVSS 301 - FUEL TANK (89 affected)

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/FMVSS 222-SEATING (18 affected)

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 301 - FUEL TANK (517 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/BATTERY CABLE HARNESS (5,000 affected)
summary: THE BATTERY CABLE HARNESS DOES NOT HAVE ADEQUATE PROTECTION FROM CONTACTING AND BEING DAMAGED BY THE RIGHT ENGINE MOUNT.

title: Utilimaster Corporation: UTILIMASTER/DRIVELINE STRAP (701 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES ARE MISSING A PROPSHAFT RETAINER STRAP.  IN THE EVENT OF A DRIVELINE DETACHMENT, THIS STRAP PREVENTS THE DRIVELINE FROM CONTACTING THE GROUND.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/AIR BAGS (164,139 affected)

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/ELECTRICAL (3,800 affected)

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/BRAKES (23,000 affected)
summary: UNDER CONDITIONS OF FULL LOCK STEERING AND FULL SUSPENSION TRAVEL, THE LEFT OR RIGHT FRONT WHEEL-SIDE BRAKE HOSE CAN CRACK, RESULTING IN BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/STEERING SHAFT (144,598 affected)
summary: THE INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT LOOSENS AT THE STEERING SHAFT TO STEERING GEAR COUPLING.  WITH THIS LOOSENESS, THE YOKE PINCH BOLT CAN WEAR ON THE SPLINES OF THE SHAFT UNTIL THERE IS NO LONGER AN INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE SPLINES AND THE BOLT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 302 - FLAMMABILITY (47 affected)
summary: THE SEAT COVER TRIM MATERIAL DOES NOT MEET THE FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 302, "FLAMMABILITY OF INTERIOR MATERIALS."

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY (84 affected)

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/POWERTRAIN DRIVE MOTORS (5 affected)

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/REAR SEAT BELTS (36,000 affected)

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: COOPER/TIRES (544 affected)
summary: THESE TIRES DO NOT HAVE ADEQUATE RUBBER COVERAGE ON THE BELT EDGE IN THE SHOULDER SLOTS.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: VOLVO/THROTTLE (12,530 affected)
summary: THE SCREWS WHICH ATTACH THE THROTTLE PLATE TO ITS AXLE (SHAFT) CAN LOOSEN ALLOWING THE THROTTLE PLATE TO COME IN CONTACT WITH THE THROTTLE HOUSING.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FMVSS 121, AIR BRAKES (500 affected)

title: IC CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/AMTRAN/HYDRAULIC BRAKE LINES (3,002 affected)
summary: A HYDRAULIC BRAKE LINE AND/OR BRAKE PAD IS MISSING IN EITHER THE PRIMARY OR SECONDARY SYSTEM.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (1,300 affected)

title: KOLCRAFT ENTERPRISES, INC.: KOLCRAFT/FMVSS 213 (51,400 affected)

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/SEAT BELT MECHANISM (120 affected)
summary: THE PASSENGER SIDE SEAT BELT MECHANISM WHICH IS FITTED WITH THE CHILD SAFETY SEAT LOCKING MECHANISM WAS FITTED ON THE DRIVER SIDE AND THE DRIVER'S SIDE SEAT BELT MECHANISM WITHOUT THE LOCKING MECHANISM FITTED ON THE PASSENGER SIDE.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: HARLEY DAVIDSON/FUEL VALVE (176,515 affected)
summary: THE EFFECTS OF REFORMULATED GASOLINE ALONG WITH CERTAIN USAGE OF THE FUEL SUPPLY VALVE AFFECTS THE SUPPLY OF GASOLINE TO THE CARBURETOR.   THIS CONDITION REQUIRES TWO FACTORS: (1) THE USE OF REFORMULATED FUELS CONTAINING MBTE AND (2) STARTING THE MOTORCYCLE WITH THE FUEL VALVE HANDLE IN THE OFF POSITION.

title: WHITE RIVER MARINE GROUP LLC: TRACKER MARINE/FENDER BRACKET (2,215 affected)
summary: THE FENDER MOUNTING BRACKET DOES NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT CLEARANCE FOR THE TIRE WHEN THE TRAILER AND BOAT ARE IN A LOADED CONDITION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/INTEGRAL CHILD SEATS (150,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: MULTIPURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH INTEGRAL CHILD SEATS.   THIS IS NOT A SAFETY RECALL IN ACCORDANCE WITH FEDERAL REGULATION 573.  HOWEVER, IT IS DEEMED A SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CAMPAIGN BY THE AGENCY.   ON THE INTEGRAL CHILD SEAT, THE SHOULDER BELTS RESTRAINING THE CHILD RETRACT AND LOCK IN PLACE AFTER THE BELT BUCKLE IS CONNECTED TO THE LATCH PLATE.  THE LATCH PLATE MOVEMENT LOCKS THE BELTS TO MAKE SURE THE CHILD IS RESTRAINED IN THE CASE OF A VEHICLE CRASH.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/GENERATOR FUEL LINE (47 affected)
summary: THE GENERATOR FUEL SUPPLY HOSE LOCATED ADJACENT TO THE GENERATOR WAS NOT ROUTED OR CLAMPED PROPERLY AND COULD COME IN CONTACT WITH THE ENGINE EXHAUST.
